sections.text: Introduction
This document out lines the testing procedure I1.

This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the relay. It is 
recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases.

The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated by eng Sawsan El_Lethy, 
tested by eng Wael Taha, revised by quality control eng. Adel Abd El_Kader 
El_Naggar at EDEP Co., accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Goda Elsaid
Safety Precautions

A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

The voltage 
transformer must be out of service

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Secondary injection test set

Test leads, 
 Clamp ammeter, and voltmeter
Complete tool set

sections.text: Works to be Carried Out

Over 
Current Test

Disconnect the 
circuit breaker for feeder

Removed the plug 
of connection for Earth fault relay.

Remove the input 
current terminal number (8,9,10&11)from terminal board ( A )

Connect test 
leads between the current terminal (8&11) for phase ( R )

Increase the 
injected current slowly until the red indication on over-current element phase ( 
R ) on the relay appears

Record this 
value on the test sheet ( adjust it if needed )

Switch off the 
test set

Repeat the above 
test from step ( 4 
) to ( 7 ) but inject current between terminal ( 9&11 ) for phase ( S ) and 
terminal ( 10&11 ) for phase ( T ) on the terminal board ( A )

sections.text: Time Test

Connect the time delayed contact numbers ( 1&2 ) on the relay to timer terminals 
on the test set ,
Start the test by injecting the pick-up current into the relay for phase ( R )

Record the value 
of time on the test sheet ( adjust it if needed )

the timer will 
stop once the relay has picked-up

Repeat the 
above test from step ( 1&4 ) for phase ( S ) & ( T )

sections.text: Trip Test
Put the circuit breaker on the test position ,
Request the operator to switch on the circuit breaker ,
Injecting the pick-up current into the relay ,
Check that the circuit breaker tripped

sections.text: Return Relay to Service
Disconnect the test leads from the terminals board ( A )
put the plug of connection for Earth fault relay
Disconnect the test leads from timer terminal on the relay

any equipment associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned 
to service by the following restoration steps.

 coil,

 failure scheme associated this relay,
